The exact mass matches closely the calculated monoisotopic mass of C₁₄H₁₂O₆ (276.0634 Da), differing by only ~3 mDa, which is within typical instrument tolerance. This formula is chemically reasonable (integer DBE = 9). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₁₄H₁₂O₆.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H12O6</final_answer>
